BiblicalUsage: Zuriel is a Levite, the chief of the house of Merari in the wilderness. In Numbers 3:35, the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Zuriel belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
